target_customer: Institutional residential landlords and property managers
problem: Applicant identity and income fraud drives rent delinquency. Cobblestone built fraud detection and income verification software for the leasing process.
business_model: B2B SaaS sold to landlords, likely per application or per unit
product_category: Proptech fraud detection and income verification

technical_complexity.rationale: Document forensics, identity checks and income verification are standard fintech engineering but need quality data sources and fraud models.

defensibility.rationale: Fraud models can improve with data, but screening vendors could add similar checks.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Rental screening vendors expanded fraud detection and the company was acquired in June 2026 by one of them, 100.

market_need_then: Institutional landlords reported rising application fraud and delinquency, though I found no dated figures near the 2023 batch.

branding.domain_note: Uses getcobblestone.com, a get prefix domain.

identity.visual_style: Landing page is a bare Cobblestone x 100 notice after the acquisition

rebrands.why: Acquired by 100, site now shows a joint notice

brand_strength.rationale: A trademark was filed in February 2024 and acquisition press mentions the name, but no source covers the brand itself. The name shares results with a wine firm and other Cobblestone companies.

outcome_analysis: Cobblestone was a three person New York team of former Ramp engineers in YC Winter 2023 selling fraud and delinquency tooling to institutional landlords. It was acquired by the rental screening company 100 in June 2026 with undisclosed terms, and the founders joined as strategic advisers. No funding history is public, so the outcome reads as a modest strategic sale by a lean team to a screening player in its own space.
notes: No funding found; StartupHub claims $10M total but also a 2021 founding year, so it is unreliable and unrecorded. The acquirer's own $5.2M pre-seed (October 2024) is not Cobblestone funding. Competitor list left empty: the dated search returned no 2023 sources, and Snappt and Findigs appear only in later material. Company site shows only Cobblestone x 100.
